import json
from datetime import date, timedelta

days = ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"]

# Q1: "moved back early" interpreted as moved earlier by 14 weeks
d = date(1999, 6, 30) - timedelta(weeks=14)
X, Y, Z = d.month, d.day, d.year
q1 = d.strftime("%m/%d/%Y")

# Q2

P = (days.index("Thursday") - Xp) % 7

Pp = (P + 60) % 7
# 03:22 PM = 15:22 on day Pp, add Yp hours
total_minutes = 15 * 60 + 22 + Yp * 60
day_shift = total_minutes // (24 * 60)
Q = (Pp + day_shift) % 7

# Q4
Zp = Z - 1984
Qp = (Q + 58) % 7
# start time anywhere in [0, 12) hours on day Qp; finish after Zp hours
ends = set()
for minute in range(0, 12 * 60):

    ends.add(days[(Qp + end_min // 1440) % 7])
ans = sorted(ends)

    }
}))
